I am 68 years old and this beans plot is only 0.31 hectares, so my family can manage the work without hiring anyone. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I do not need to waste expensive chemical fertilizer on this plot, especially since I need to save any FISP coupons for my maize. I will plant seed I kept from last season because improved bean seed is difficult to find in our area, and I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves over the season.
